notes.milestones: Row id or `prefix*` to the milestone of docs/plans/rca-parity/plan.md section 6 in which the row becomes served; the longest match wins. aiVault.* and orchestration.party* stay pending until decision 1 (by M7); pairing.* until decision 1 (by M5).
notes.reverify: Row id to why a trace hit does not serve it yet: the host answers without doing the work. A call that only passes by refusing or by an empty answer never counts; remove the note in the commit that makes the answer functional and reverified through the chain.
notes.traceNoise: Row id or `prefix*` to why a trace may name a row the phone does not reach (the crawl drives the whole host surface): `wf parity coverage --traces` does not report such a row as unknown-trace-row. A row the phone reaches never needs one, and a mistyped row a test names is not noise.
notes.decisions: Rows with a state other than pending: not-offered needs a reason and a decidedBy milestone, excluded a reason. Flagged (ORCA_SIDEBAR_INPUTS_IS_MAIN) and off-allowlist rows are classed by the scan itself. No row is marked served here: served needs run-bundle evidence. A row may carry `"oracle": "mimic"` (docs/plans/mimic/plan.md): only a `wf mimic replay --suite` trace whose call is labelled clean or allowlisted on a `recorded` cassette serves it, never a chain test.

traceNoise.rpc:layout.*: the desktop window's workspace layout (apply, snapshots, held panes, view reports, subscribe): the scan finds no phone caller, and the recorded crawl drives the host's whole method surface, so its trace names them without a phone row to serve
traceNoise.rpc:sidebarInputs.*: the desktop sidebar's inputs (activity, desktop and review facts, paired server rows, workspace rows and creations, temporal, report view): no phone caller in the scan; the crawl names them, and the two phone rows (read, repoIcons) are flagged rows the scan classes itself
traceNoise.rpc:sidebarSession.begin: opens the desktop sidebar's input session: no phone caller in the scan, named by the crawl alone
traceNoise.rpc:session.readTerminalScrollback: reads a terminal's scrollback for the desktop's execution host: no phone caller in the scan (the phone reads a terminal through terminal.subscribe, a pending M8 row), named by the crawl alone
